question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'yelling' in the given sentence.

The shouting and exclaiming gestures of Smita led to the whispering regarding her behaviour, and everyone in the party started monitoring her.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (whispering)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"yelling"** means to shout or cry out loudly, often in anger or excitement. (चिल्लाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher started yelling at the students for not paying attention in class.
 
 

 
• The word **"whispering"** refers to speaking very softly or quietly, often in a way that is barely audible and used to avoid being overheard. (फुसफुसाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The children were whispering secrets to each other during the lecture.
 
 

 
• Since "yelling" involves loud noise and "whispering" involves quiet or soft speech, they are antonyms. Hence, the opposite of 'yelling' is 'whispering'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (whispering)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: Monitoring** (निरीक्षण करना): Observing or checking something over a period of time. 
 
 
• **Example:** The security guard is monitoring the cameras to ensure safety.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: Shouting** (चिल्लाना): Speaking loudly, often in anger or excitement; it is similar to yelling and not an antonym.
 
 
• **Example:** She was shouting instructions to her team during the match.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: Exclaiming** (उद्घोषणा करना): Speaking or crying out suddenly and loudly due to surprise, emotion, or excitement. 
 
 
• **Example:** The child was exclaiming with joy after receiving his gift.
